content.rendered:
The first CCRA breakfast in years on May 22nd was a great success!  Now is the time to plan to attend the next two breakfasts…

Thanks to the efforts of Trevor, WA6JAU, and Mitchell, W8DOD, the CCRA had a very successful first group breakfast reunion on May 22nd!  Everyone had such a good time that the CCRA has made reservations at Legends & Heroes Sports Bar at 9 AM for June 19th and July 17th.  Legends is located at at the Diablo Creek Golf Course at 4050 Port Chicago Highway in North Concord.  Please click the link below for map directions.

View Larger Map

Please make plans to attend by circling June 19th and July 17th on your calenders!

Those of you who were unable to make the meeting missed a very special “family” reunion.  But don’t despair!  Make plans on attending the next get-togethers in June and July.  I hope to see all of you there!

73…Steve, WA6HAM
